s2:Double tidal disruption events with supermassive black hole binaries, 2019-07-01

rationale: The paper 1808.04531 directly investigates the rates of TDEs in relation to black hole mass functions and compares theoretical predictions with observed rates, contributing substantive evidence to part of the question. However, it does not fully settle the question regarding different black hole mass seed models and the black hole mass - bulge mass relation for dwarf galaxies.
